h1: React Native migration and version upgrades
overview: Your app may be native Swift or Kotlin, Cordova, Ionic or an old React Native release. We start with a short plan that lists what moves, in what order and how your users' data carries over. Then we rebuild or upgrade inside your repository, keep the same app ID so updates reach current users, and test the main journeys on real devices before handover.

faq: Can you migrate an app that is already in the stores?
Yes. We keep the same bundle ID and package name, so the new version ships as an update to the app people already have. Nothing is published until you approve it.
Will my users lose their data?
No, that is the main thing we protect. We map every stored item first, move it with a tested script and check it on a copy of real data before the update goes out.
Which old frameworks can you move from?
Native Swift and Kotlin, Cordova, Ionic, Xamarin and older React Native releases are common. Tell us what you have and we confirm the route before you order.
What if a native feature has no React Native version?
We either find a maintained library or write a small native module for it. If a feature is too large for your package, we say so in the plan and quote it separately.
